_description: Gain Guardian thresholds — engine reads fresh each run (Phase 191 shadow-thresholds pattern). NOTHING publishes until published=true, flipped by the operator via --promote after the 10-trading-day shadow window.

weights._comment: Parabolic score 0-100 = sum of weight * normalized component

normalize._comment: Component x maps to [0,1]: ext50_atr/ext_max, (rsi-rsi_lo)/(rsi_hi-rsi_lo), rvol/rvol_max, streak/streak_max, (accel-1)/(accel_max-1); all clamped
